Question: Assalamoalaikum,i jokingly typed talak talak talak to my wife on skype chat asuming that she was going to give me divorce the next day of which i was very sure but it not happen and she extended the date .i dont understand islam very much and did not know nothing about hoe talaq works.we love each other very much and want to be together but right now caught in this thing.want to know a way out of this other than halalah. Answer ID: 26075 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2372/H=856/th=1431) When you gave three talaqs, all the three took place. No matter whether the woman gives talaq or not. Your wife became haram for you whether you are aware from the commandment of Islam more or less. Neither you have the right to take her back nor solemnize new nikah without a valid halalah. After the completion of iddah period, the woman can marry where she wishes except you. It is proved from Bukhari (Vol. 2, P. 791) and Fatawa al-Hindiyah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
